name: YouTrack
short_desc: Project management and issue tracker by JetBrains
author: JetBrains
description: YouTrack is a project management and issue tracking tool by JetBrains. It supports agile boards, Gantt charts, knowledge base articles, workflows and time tracking. On first start, complete the Configuration Wizard: the wizard token is printed in the container logs and also stored at /opt/youtrack/conf/internal/services/configurationWizard/wizard_token.txt inside the container (conf volume).
